def find_pattern(n, m, filenames, indices):
    # Extract the filenames to be deleted
    to_delete = [filenames[i - 1] for i in indices]
    
    # Determine the length of the filenames to be deleted
    length = len(to_delete[0])
    
    # Check if all filenames to be deleted have the same length
    if any(len(f) != length for f in to_delete):
        return "No"
    
    # Generate the pattern
    pattern = []
    for i in range(length):
        char_set = set(f[i] for f in to_delete)
        if '?' in char_set:
            char_set.remove('?')
        if len(char_set) == 1:
            pattern.append('?')
        else:
            pattern.append('.')
    
    # Check if the generated pattern matches all filenames to be deleted
    if all(f.startswith(''.join(pattern)) for f in filenames):
        return "Yes\n" + ''.join(pattern)
    else:
        return "No"

# Read input
n, m = map(int, input().split())
filenames = [input().strip() for _ in range(n)]
indices = list(map(int, input().split()))

# Output the result
print(find_pattern(n, m, filenames, indices))
